Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
privacy is likely to become a thing of the past in some public or commercial contexts but less likely to vanish everywhere because laws and privacy preserving tools may remain privacy
consciousness copying by early 2030s is very unlikely because we lack a complete map of subjective experience and scalable brain computer interfaces consciousness
wireless internet anywhere is likely in broad terms if satellites and mobile networks expand but still unlikely to be perfectly universal due to terrain power infrastructure and cost wireless
transport becoming fully electric is likely for many cars and buses but less likely for all planes ships trains and specialized vehicles within foreseeable decades transport
climate effects being irreversible is likely for some changes like ice sheet loss ocean warming and extinction events though many impacts can be slowed or partially managed climate
money in physical form is less likely to vanish completely because cash may remain for resilience and inclusion although notes and coins could become rare money
genetic longevity breakthroughs allowing centuries or immortality are very unlikely in the near term and perhaps forever is speculative though extending healthy lifespan is plausible genetic
